tests.command: pkgs=$(for f in $A2DLC_TESTS; do echo ./$(dirname $f); done | sort -u); gotestsum --format dots --junitfile "$A2DLC_JUNIT" -- -count=1 -coverpkg=./... -coverprofile=/tmp/c.out $pkgs; rc=$?; gocover-cobertura < /tmp/c.out > "$A2DLC_COVERAGE"; exit $rc
tests.baseline_command: pkgs=$(for f in $A2DLC_CHANGED $A2DLC_TESTS; do case $f in *.go) echo ./$(dirname $f);; esac; done | sort -u); [ -n "$pkgs" ] || pkgs=./cmd/a2dlc; gotestsum --format dots --junitfile "$A2DLC_JUNIT" -- -count=1 -coverpkg=./... -coverprofile=/tmp/c.out $pkgs; rc=$?; gocover-cobertura < /tmp/c.out > "$A2DLC_COVERAGE"; exit $rc
